summary.headline: Zodiacal Signs and Stellar Doctrines
summary.text: Chapters 34–53 treat zodiacal signs associated with animals, plants, water and fire, bodily states, colors, ascension, and length, followed by doctrines of stellar disposition, solar configurations, places of power, latitude, conjunctions, configurations, strength, enclosure, numbers, and properties, with separate chapters on Jupiter, Mars, and the Sun.
